draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.31, the 45th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 1st of 18 at TE. He went 55th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Austin Hooper. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (85th percentile). College production: his final season (2021) ranked 1st in receiving yards among the 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals. 66 career games and 58 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 10 AV in 2025 against a career-best 11 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: team target share 27.4% (100th percentile), receiving td 11 (100th percentile), receiving yards 1,239 (99th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 1,239 receiving yards against a median of 179, above the norm.
